title: At 24% APR, Debt Doubles Fast: Pick Your Method
hook_text: AT 24% APR DEBT DOUBLES EVERY 3 YEARS

beats.say: At 24% APR, debt doubles every 3 years using the rule of 72, trapping millions.
beats.visual: A dark room lit by a single desk lamp, casting sharp shadows on a plain wooden table.

beats.say: You can't outsave high interest unless you pick a proven payoff method right now.
beats.visual: Close-up of a silver pen resting on a blank white sheet of paper, soft focus background.

beats.say: Step one. List every debt you owe by interest rate and balance on a fresh sheet.
beats.visual: A hand writing numbers on paper with a black ink pen, shot from directly above.

beats.say: Step two. Choose the avalanche method to attack your highest APR balance first.
beats.visual: A hand sliding a calculator across a clean wooden desk, cinematic lighting.

beats.say: Or choose the snowball method to kill your smallest balance first for quick momentum.
beats.visual: A stack of plain white index cards being sorted on a dark surface, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: Step three. Route every extra dollar to that single target while paying minimums elsewhere.
beats.visual: A single dark coffee mug sitting next to a closed notebook on a minimalist desk.

beats.say: Look at what happens on a $3,000 balance at 24% APR when you change your payment.
beats.visual: A blurred computer keyboard with soft blue ambient light reflecting off the keys.

beats.say: Paying only the minimum drags it out for 183 months and costs $4,887 in interest.
beats.visual: A close-up of a brass desk clock ticking in a quiet room, cinematic moody lighting.

beats.say: But paying $300 a month wipes it clean in just 12 months with only $381 in interest.
beats.visual: A hand closing a plain leather notebook with a crisp snap, warm backlighting.

beats.say: That's the power of intentional math over minimum payments that drain your paycheck.
beats.visual: A silhouette of a person standing by a tall glass window looking out at a city skyline at dusk.

beats.say: Pick your strategy today and follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single warm light at the far end, minimalist perspective shot.

beats.say: At 24% APR, debt doubles every 3 years
beats.visual: A sleek dark room with a minimalist chair by a blank wall, quiet documentary atmosphere.

caption: Stop letting minimum payments drain your paycheck. Pick your method today. #debtfree #personalfinance #moneymindset #debtpayoff #wealthbuilding
description: Learn how to choose between the debt avalanche and debt snowball methods to eliminate high-interest debt fast using exact math.
